purpose: Prepare Audio Studio as part of the same TranslateIT V1 engine for future custom English voice actor creation from user samples.

route_state_semantics.metadata_ready: UserData project metadata route completed without claiming provider/audio readiness.
route_state_semantics.provider_blocked: Provider, capture, generation, or quality route is intentionally unavailable until implemented and locally verified.
route_state_semantics.ready: Reserved for fully implemented runtime behavior with target-PC evidence.

rules: Audio Studio remains part of the same TranslateIT V1 engine and must not become a separate engine.
Metadata routes must return metadata_ready instead of generic ready.
Provider routes must remain provider_blocked until real runtime implementation and target-PC evidence exist.
Do not use UserData/LogData for Audio Studio evidence logs; use UserData/CacheData/AudioStudio/logs/.
Do not claim generated audio or custom voice actor readiness from project metadata routes.
